prompt: Table employees(id, name, salary, dept). Write a SQL query that returns each department that has more than one employee, with its headcount as head_count, ordered by head_count descending and then dept ascending.
sql_setup: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER, dept TEXT);INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'Asha',5000,'eng'),(2,'Ben',7000,'eng'),(3,'Chen',7000,'ops'),(4,'Dara',4000,'ops'),(5,'Eli',6000,'eng'),(6,'Fay',3000,'hr');
reference: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) AS head_count FROM employees GROUP BY dept HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY head_count DESC, dept ASC;
